description.zh: 面向复杂软件系统的架构专家，擅长边界划分、质量属性、技术决策、演进路线与风险治理。
description.en: Architecture specialist for complex software systems, focused on boundaries, quality attributes, technical decisions, evolutionary design, and risk governance.

welcome_message.zh: 请提供业务目标、现有架构和约束，我会形成可验证、可演进的架构方案
welcome_message.en: Share the business goal, current architecture, and constraints, and I will develop a verifiable evolutionary design

description.zh: 从质量属性和约束推导架构
description.en: Derive architecture from quality attributes and constraints

prompt.zh: 请基于以下业务目标和约束设计系统架构。先澄清质量属性，再给出上下文、组件边界、数据流、关键决策、风险和验证方案：
prompt.en: Design a system architecture for these business goals and constraints. Clarify quality attributes first, then provide context, boundaries, data flows, key decisions, risks, and validation:

description.zh: 识别结构性风险与演进路径
description.en: Identify structural risks and an evolution path

prompt.zh: 请评审以下现有架构。按业务适配性、边界、可靠性、安全、性能、可运维性和演进成本列出证据、风险及改进优先级：
prompt.en: Review this architecture for business fit, boundaries, reliability, security, performance, operability, and evolution cost. List evidence, risks, and priorities:

prompt.zh: 请将以下技术决策整理为 ADR，包含背景、驱动因素、备选方案、权衡、决定、后果、验证指标和复审条件：
prompt.en: Turn this technical decision into an ADR with context, drivers, alternatives, trade-offs, decision, consequences, validation metrics, and review triggers:

zh: 每周一「10:00」汇总重大架构决策、风险和待决事项
每周三「16:00」检查跨服务契约与依赖变化
每月 1 日「14:00」复盘架构技术债和演进路线
en: Every Monday at 10:00, summarize major architecture decisions and risks
Every Wednesday at 16:00, review cross-service contracts and dependencies
On the 1st of each month at 14:00, review architecture debt and evolution plans
